analysis: This batch contains comment-only changes. EngineV2Bridge.swift head lines 132-136 reword the kvBytesPerToken doc comment. It now states that ordinary CBv2 slots price observed native per-layer K/V types via EngineV2SlotFactory.slotKVBytesPerToken. EngineV2Factory+Configuration.swift head lines 201-203 recast nativeKVBytesPerToken as a fallback for callers without observed native types and note that it over-reserves bf16 rows. No executable code changed in the supplied units. Bridge init, the SSD prefix-cache wiring (T-041: complete-store identity check, close on rejection, resident-evidence gating) and the KV budget fields are identical between base and head. The comments imply a behavioral change elsewhere in this PR: production KV pricing moves from the nominal fp16 rate plus GPT-OSS delta to observed per-layer types in EngineV2SlotFactory.slotKVBytesPerToken, which is not in this batch. If that observed rate under-estimates actual residency, GlobalKVCacheBudget admission could over-admit and exhaust memory. That is an availability risk under TB-007, and T-041 transient staging reservations share the same budget. Integration should check that the slot factory derives the rate from the actual allocated K/V dtypes, including the fp32 owning-full rows that the old fallback added. It should also check that saturation and overflow handling is preserved and that heartbeats and reservations use the same value. No confidentiality, attestation or authorization surface is touched by these units.
